message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('src/md4c.c').read_text()
# hook before switch any type>=9 abort with input logged by harness? use fuzzer harness global
s=s.replace('#include <string.h>','#include <string.h>\nextern void bad_start_hook(int type);')
s=s.replace('static int\nmd_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)\n{\n    MD_BLOCK* block;', 'static int\nmd_start_new_block(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)\n{\n    if(line->type >= 9) bad_start_hook(line->type);\n    MD_BLOCK* block;')
Path('/tmp/md4c_tablehook.c').write_text(s)
PY
cc -O2 -I src /tmp/fuzz_bad.c /tmp/md4c_tablehook.c src/md4c-html.c src/entity.c -o /tmp/fuzz_tablehook && timeout 60 /tmp/fuzz_tablehook > /tmp/fuzz_tablehook.out 2>/tmp/fuzz_tablehook.err; rc=$?; echo RC=$rc; tail -80 /tmp/fuzz_tablehook.err
